verdicts.reason: Both are very wide, short banners. A: the headline is large and readable on the left, but the turbine icon is tiny and jammed into the right corner, overlapping the shapes. The green and blue triangles are crushed into a cluster, and there is a huge dead gap between the text and the graphics. B: the headline is smaller but centered, with the icon and shapes in a row beneath it. The result is cramped vertically, the text sits very close to the top edge, and the icon and triangles are tiny with faint decoration lines. B groups the elements more coherently and keeps the shapes distinct, so it is marginally less bad.
